description:
We want to change the world. We’re a team of fast-executing social entrepreneurs on a mission to build the future of social change. We’ve bootstrapped our development so far, but we’ve gotten to a critical point in our growth where we want to take on a technical lead. This is an opportunity to shape the company’s tech culture and design the technical foundation for a large-scale, cross-platform application.

We’re not looking for someone to do busy work or implement another Rails app. We are searching for an outstanding full-stack developer to join our founding team as the lead of our growing technical staff.

We don’t want a code monkey; we don’t want someone to say yes and implement every feature we ask for. What we want is a partner. Someone to bounce ideas off of, someone with a vision for the future of our company, and someone who has the desire and drive to make it a reality.


 Time and Pay: 
This is primarily an equity position, with a negotiable stipend to start. We’re looking for a long-term partner and engineering lead; this position will grow with iFLIP4. We are located in East Hanover, NJ.

Please send your resume to Team [at] iFLIP4.com Preference will be given to those who apply earliest.

 Technical Requirements: 
 Design & Typography Background - Should be ready to shape the look & feel of the brand as well as the glue that keeps it all together
 Extensive experience developing and maintaining templates, using add-ons, and optimizing for efficient and reliable performance
 PHP (5+, OO PHP), and MySQL/SQL Database Experience (LAMP stack)
 HTML/HTML5
 CSS (LESS/SASS is a plus), Webfonts
 Javascript (DOM, client-side MVC frameworks are a plus)
 Git, software engineering best practices (TDD, Scrum? You decide!)
 You care as much about UX/UI as you do about O() and normalizing DBs
 Familiar with A/B testing, analytics, and pivoting quickly
 Expert in ExpressionEngine CMS Platform (codeignitor experience a plus)
 Sysadmin/Scaling experience (site is Rackspace hosted)
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Systems Engineering or similar preferred
 
 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
